decision.summary: The CP12 issued 2025-10-17 is valid to 2026-10-16, so the property is compliant today. The tenant has ignored three contacts. I opened JOB-101, re-contacted the tenant by email and SMS, asked HeatRight for a slot, updated the landlord and set a follow-up for 12 Oct.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, expires 2026-10-16, Gas Safe engineer 550123, a structured record with a file) over the legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good', which is vague, undated as to the certificate and from the old agency. The two don't actually conflict. It lapses after 16 Oct.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Opened job, emailed and texted the tenant for times, asked HeatRight (preferred, Gas Safe) for availability, will give 24h written notice before any visit, follow up 12 Oct with a phone call and letter, escalate to compliance if no access by 13 Oct. No entry without notice; holding keys gives no right of entry.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Compliant until 16 Oct, tenant unresponsive since 25 Sep, what we've done, that we will not enter without notice, and that we'll update him and ask before spend over £300.
